

---
title: "Analyzing Americans' Time Use"
author: "Emma Acedo Lapieza"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = "data/atus.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)

dbplyr_act <- tbl(con, "activities")
dbplyr_resp <- tbl(con, "respondents")
dbplyr_codes <- tbl(con, "activity_codes")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

activity_avg <- dbplyr_act |>
  left_join(dbplyr_codes |> select(activity_code, major_name),
            by = "activity_code") |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_resp |>
               filter(str_starts(employment_status, "Not"),
                      day_type == "Weekday") |>
               select(tucaseid, sex),
             by = "tucaseid") |>
  group_by(tucaseid, sex, major_name) |>
  summarize(daily_min = sum(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(sex, major_name) |>
  summarize(avg_daily_min = mean(daily_min, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
keep_cats <- c(
  "Personal Care Activities",
  "Household Activities",
  "Caring For & Helping Household (HH) Members",
  "Socializing, Relaxing, and Leisure"
)

hourly_avg <- dbplyr_act |>
  mutate(hour = start_hhmm %/% 100L) |>
  filter(hour >= 6L, hour <= 23L) |>
  left_join(dbplyr_codes |> select(activity_code, major_name),
            by = "activity_code") |>
  filter(major_name %in% keep_cats) |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_resp |>
               filter(str_starts(employment_status, "Not"),
                      day_type == "Weekday") |>
               select(tucaseid, sex),
             by = "tucaseid") |>
  group_by(sex, hour, major_name) |>
  summarize(avg_min = mean(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  collect()

hourly_avg
```

```{r}
activity_avg |>
  filter(major_name != "Data Codes") |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = reorder(major_name, avg_daily_min),
    y = avg_daily_min,
    fill = sex
  )) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "How Americans Spend Their Time",
    subtitle = "Average daily minutes by activity and sex among non-employed weekday respondents",
    x = "Activity Category",
    y = "Average Daily Minutes",
    fill = "Sex",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey (ATUS)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
hourly_avg |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = hour,
    y = avg_min,
    fill = major_name
  )) +
  geom_area() +
  facet_wrap(~ sex, ncol = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(6, 23, by = 2),
    labels = function(x) {
      paste0((x - 1) %% 12 + 1, ifelse(x < 12, " AM", " PM"))
    }
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "How Americans Spend Their Day",
    subtitle = "Average minutes spent on activities by hour and sex among non-employed weekday respondents",
    x = "Time of Day",
    y = "Average Minutes",
    fill = "Activity Category",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey (ATUS)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
